## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:all` passes
- [ ] Detector changes: positive **and** negative tests added, versions bumped, provenance documented, `npm run eval` reviewed
- [ ] No scan data, third-party screenshots, downloaded assets or secrets are included
- [ ] No unsupported accuracy, model-attribution or "% AI-generated" claims
